Database: f1_db

Table: circuits
- circuit_id integer
- circuit_ref text
- name text
- location text
- country text
- lat double precision
- lng double precision
- alt integer
- url text
Table: constructor_results
- constructor_results_id integer
- race_id integer
- constructor_id integer
- points numeric
- status text
Table: constructor_standings
- constructor_standings_id integer
- race_id integer
- constructor_id integer
- points numeric
- position integer
- position_text text
- wins integer
Table: constructors
- constructor_id integer
- constructor_ref text
- name text
- nationality text
- url text
Table: driver_standings
- driver_standings_id integer
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- points numeric
- position integer
- position_text text
- wins integer
Table: drivers
- driver_id integer
- driver_ref text
- number integer
- code character varying
- forename text
- surname text
- dob date
- nationality text
- url text
Table: lap_times
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- lap integer
- position integer
- time text
- milliseconds integer
Table: pit_stops
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- stop integer
- lap integer
- time time without time zone
- duration text
- milliseconds integer
Table: practice_results
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- session text
- position integer
- best_lap_time interval
- laps integer
Table: qualifying
- qualify_id integer
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- constructor_id integer
- number integer
- position integer
- q1 text
- q2 text
- q3 text
Table: races
- race_id integer
- year integer
- round integer
- circuit_id integer
- name text
- date date
- time time without time zone
- url text
- fp1_date date
- fp1_time time without time zone
- fp2_date date
- fp2_time time without time zone
- fp3_date date
- fp3_time time without time zone
- quali_date date
- quali_time time without time zone
- sprint_date date
- sprint_time time without time zone
Table: results
- result_id integer
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- constructor_id integer
- number integer
- grid integer
- position integer
- position_text text
- position_order integer
- points numeric
- laps integer
- time text
- milliseconds integer
- fastest_lap integer
- rank integer
- fastest_lap_time text
- fastest_lap_speed numeric
- status_id integer
Table: seasons
- year integer
- url text
Table: sprint_results
- result_id integer
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- constructor_id integer
- number integer
- grid integer
- position integer
- position_text text
- position_order integer
- points numeric
- laps integer
- time text
- milliseconds integer
- fastest_lap integer
- fastest_lap_time text
- status_id integer
Table: status
- status_id integer
- status text
Table: tire_stints
- race_id integer
- driver_id integer
- stint integer
- compound text
- start_lap integer
- end_lap integer
- laps_on_tire integer
Table: weather
- race_id integer
- air_temp_avg numeric
- air_temp_min numeric
- air_temp_max numeric
- track_temp_avg numeric
- track_temp_min numeric
- track_temp_max numeric
- humidity_avg numeric
- wind_speed_avg numeric
- wind_speed_max numeric
- rainfall boolean

Relationships:
- constructor_results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- constructor_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- constructor_standings.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- constructor_standings.race_id -> races.race_id
- driver_standings.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- driver_standings.race_id -> races.race_id
- lap_times.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- lap_times.race_id -> races.race_id
- pit_stops.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- pit_stops.race_id -> races.race_id
- practice_results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- practice_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- qualifying.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- qualifying.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- qualifying.race_id -> races.race_id
- races.circuit_id -> circuits.circuit_id
- races.year -> seasons.year
- results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- results.race_id -> races.race_id
- results.status_id -> status.status_id
- sprint_results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- sprint_results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- sprint_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- sprint_results.status_id -> status.status_id
- tire_stints.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- tire_stints.race_id -> races.race_id
- weather.race_id -> races.race_id

Important notes:
- A driver's full name is drivers.forename plus drivers.surname.
- results contains only main races; sprint races are in sprint_results.
- results.position is NULL when the driver was not classified; position_text then holds a code (R = retired, D = disqualified, E = excluded, W = withdrew, F = failed to qualify, N = not classified). position_order orders every driver of a race. A race win is results.position = 1.
- driver_standings and constructor_standings are cumulative after each race; a season's final standings are the ones after its last race (the highest round of that year).
- Lap and race times are stored as text (lap_times.time, results.time, fastest_lap_time, q1-q3, pit_stops.duration); use the milliseconds columns to compare or calculate times.
- Data coverage: qualifying from 1994, lap_times from 1996, pit_stops from 2011, sprint_results from 2021; practice_results, tire_stints and weather only for 2025-2026. The 2026 season is incomplete.
